editorial: You follow Sam Reide, a man who can jump back in time by focusing on photos, as he tries to solve his girlfriend's murder and clear an innocent man from death row. The movie has a dark, tense mood, with each trip to the past changing the present in scary and surprising ways. It feels like a crime thriller mixed with sci-fi, and the stakes keep rising as a dangerous serial killer gets loose. The acting is solid, and the time-travel rules are easy to follow, which helps the story stay engaging from start to finish. Some scenes feel repetitive, and the ending is very dark, so it may not be for everyone. If you like twisty thrillers, stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray. It is a good pick for a late-night watch with friends who enjoy crime stories and dark mysteries.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Sam realizes his sister Jenna has the same time-travel power and is the serial killer behind the murders. To stop her for good, he travels back and kills her as a child. This ends the killings, but it also destroys his own family life and leaves him alone with the painful truth and the guilt of what he did. He saves many lives, but he loses the sister he once loved.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark time-travel thrillers and crime mysteries.
